import numpy as np
import copy
model={'omega': [0.7, 1.15], 'coordinate': [1.0, -0.6], 'beta': 1.8, 'energies': [0.0, 1.8, 3.05], 'shifts': [[0.0, 0.0], [0.42, -0.26], [-0.31, 0.37]], 'mu0': [[0.0, 1.0, 0.35], [1.0, 0.0, 0.8], [0.35, 0.8, 0.0]], 'mu1': [[0.0, 0.18, -0.11], [0.18, 0.0, 0.14], [-0.11, 0.14, 0.0]]}
nodes=[0.17, 0.49, 0.96, 1.51]
weights=[0.22, 0.38, 0.47, 0.31]
frequencies=[1.4, -0.9]
waits=[0.23, 0.41, 0.19]
damping=0.08

def pack(x):
    x=np.asarray(x,complex)
    return np.stack((x.real,x.imag),-1)
rng=np.random.default_rng(73)
u=pack(.1*(rng.normal(size=(3,2,5))+1j*rng.normal(size=(3,2,5))))
v=pack(.1*(rng.normal(size=(3,2,5))+1j*rng.normal(size=(3,2,5))))
assert np.allclose(gaussian_generator(*copy.deepcopy((u, v, -0.3, [0.7, 1.2], 1.4))), target)
